title: Evaluation of Dimensional Accuracy of 3D printed mandibular model using two different Additive Manufacturing Techniques based on Ultra-Low Dose Multislice Computed Tomography scan data
protocol: Record 10 predetermined linear measurements using a digital calliper.
Transform DICOM file to STL format.
Use STL file for 3D printing models using SLS printer.
Use STL file for 3D printing models using FFF printer.
Record same 10 predetermined linear measurements on the printed models.
Compare recorded measurements of the reference standard with those of the 3D printed models.
